text:
You need support for accounts management and Tally Prime customization, with one person handling data entry, invoicing, and payment reconciliation, and another tailoring Tally Prime to your business requirements.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to help with the accounts management side of this work as well as support the data handling behind a smooth accounting process. I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, and I’m comfortable working with structured financial data, reconciliations, and day-to-day reporting tasks.

For the accounts management role, I can assist with accurate data entry, invoice tracking, and payment reconciliation with attention to detail and consistency. I understand how important clean records and reliable matching are in accounting workflows, and I’m used to organizing data in a way that makes review and follow-up easier. If your team already has a workflow in place, I can adapt to it; if you need help organizing and improving the structure of the records, I can support that as well.

I also work well with Excel and Google Sheets, which are useful for maintaining account logs, checking mismatches, and preparing summaries. My background in data analysis and cleaning helps me catch inconsistencies, standardize information, and keep records ready for reporting or handoff. If needed, I can also build clear dashboards or reporting views in Power BI to help you monitor account activity more easily.

I should note that my experience is strongest in data and reporting rather than Tally Prime customization itself, so if you are looking for the TDL and Tally Prime specialist mentioned in your post, I would recommend pairing me with someone who has direct customization experience. From my side, I can provide dependable support on the accounting operations and data management portion of the work.

If you’d like someone detail-oriented who can keep your accounting data organized, accurate, and easy to work with, I’d be happy to discuss your current process and how I can fit into it.
